sections.heading: Objective 1: Autonomous Customer Service Agent
bullets: Building on last period's multi-agent system, we rebuilt the agent's knowledge base by mining historical resolved tickets into 292 curated articles, and gave the agent a search tool over it so its answers are grounded in real policy rather than the model's memory.
We added a two-stage review filter that drops facts the system can look up itself and auto-accepts tool-verified facts before founder review, so the founder only rules on genuine conflicts.
We introduced a structured review-sheet loop where the founder gives free-text rulings on conflicting responses, and folded 17 of those rulings into the agent as explicit voice and behaviour rules.

We ran a controlled head-to-head evaluation of a newer, more capable AI model (Opus 5) against our current model on accuracy, latency, and cost, and rejected it after it failed all three acceptance criteria.

sections.heading: Objective 1: Measuring and Extending Autonomy
bullets: We extended our shadow-mode auto-send experiment to also judge responses that the founder had steered before regenerating, giving us a would-have-sent verdict on a wider slice of tickets.

We conducted a formal review of whether to graduate any category to real autonomous sending and judged the agent not yet ready, scheduling re-review for September, an honest checkpoint against the 80% resolution target.

We hardened the agent's order-changing actions so unshipped orders stay frozen during edits, exchange amounts settle against what the customer actually paid, and swaps never silently double-ship or skip billing.

sections.heading: Objective 1: Platform Reliability
bullets: We added automatic retries on transient network and server failures when the agent reads from the helpdesk, reducing tickets that fail to load or process.
We fixed several data-integrity and security faults (webhook authentication bypass, secret leakage, finance-snapshot corruption, and lost customer emails) surfaced by an internal code review.

sections.heading: Objective 2: Partner Channel Discovery and Onboarding
bullets: Building on last period's outreach engine, we shipped a full working partner console: operators can browse past outreach, edit and send AI drafts, attach generated partner agreements, and book onboarding calls without leaving the panel.

We taught the system to match inbound replies by sender domain and to recognise that a shared email thread can represent two separate relationships, a fix that surfaced history for four previously blank partners.

We built pause, snooze, and follow-up handling so a scheduled check-in is not treated as work waiting on the operator and a reply from years earlier is never mistaken for an answer to a recent message.
